name: nexus
description: Nexus — BSV wallet + browser across mobile and desktop

scripts.dev:wallet: NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_DATA=0 NEXT_PUBLIC_SURFACES=wallet,browser npm run dev --prefix apps/ui
scripts.build:mac: npm run ui:bundle && npm --workspace @nexus/desktop run pack:mac
scripts.build:win: npm run ui:bundle && npm --workspace @nexus/desktop run pack:win
scripts.build:linux: npm run ui:bundle && npm --workspace @nexus/desktop run pack:linux
scripts.build:ios: node tools/version.mjs --check-native && npm run ui:bundle && npm --prefix apps/mobile run build:ios:dev
scripts.build:android: node tools/version.mjs --check-native && npm run ui:bundle && npm --prefix apps/mobile run build:android:dev
scripts.build:android:prod: node tools/version.mjs --check-native && npm run ui:bundle && npm --prefix apps/mobile run build:android:prod
scripts.build:ios:prod: node tools/version.mjs --check-native && npm run ui:bundle && npm --prefix apps/mobile run build:ios:prod
